scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @eugene-p/iterum-server" "npm run dev -w @eugene-p/iterum-frontend"
scripts.prod: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate -w @eugene-p/iterum-server && npm run start
scripts.prod:build: npm run build -w @eugene-p/iterum-shared && npm run build -w @eugene-p/iterum-server && npm run build -w @eugene-p/iterum-frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @eugene-p/iterum-frontend && npm run test -w @eugene-p/iterum-server
